product-description.md [no source label]: This educational study pack focuses on the hypothalamic-pituitary axis, covering key components including the hypothalamic-pituitary-ovarian (HPO) axis and the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis. It is designed for medical students and healthcare learners seeking to understand the physiology, pathophysiology, and clinical relevance of these neuroendocrine systems.

product-description.md [no source label]: This content is intended for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for medical diagnosis or treatment. All information presented is based on current peer-reviewed literature and is intended to support learning, not to offer medical advice.
